codex.thesift.baton.body: Strikes as hard as a sword. Use it to flick a single sonic note down the line you point at, hurting the first creature in its way. It needs a moment to recover between notes.
codex.thesift.baton.title: Conductor's Baton
codex.thesift.bubble_gun.body: Built from Tuba Bubbles, copper and gold. Each squeeze blows a big wobbly bubble that pops on whatever it hits, stinging a little and lifting it gently into the air. No ammo needed, just a breath between shots.
codex.thesift.bubble_gun.title: Bubble Gun
codex.thesift.bulb.body: Bulbs hop all over the plains, squashing on every landing and leaving a little trail of tinted slime. Feed them Pitcher Bulbs to breed them; happy Bulbs plop out Glowing Slime Balls. Play music and they dance. Four colours: sky, blossom, dusk and the rare starry.
codex.thesift.bulb.title: Bulb
codex.thesift.chrome.body: A shifting cyan pearl liquid. Soaking in Chrome heals you, but it is thick like quicksand and you sink slowly: hold Shift to rise. Collect it with a bucket.
codex.thesift.chrome.title: Chrome
codex.thesift.chrome_well.body: Little wells of Chrome in the plains and dunes, often with a chest of Chrome Pearls and buckets hidden nearby.
codex.thesift.chrome_well.title: Chrome Well
codex.thesift.conga_drum.body: Use it to beat a massive shockwave: soft blocks around you shatter and everything nearby is hurled away. It takes half a minute to ring out before you can play it again. Sneak and tap it to drum single notes instead - look up for higher ones. Stompers love it.
codex.thesift.conga_drum.title: Conga Drum
codex.thesift.crane_flute.body: Hold use on a creature: a thin red line marks it, and a moment later the flute locks on - a sonic beam that hurts and slows it for as long as you keep playing and keep it in sight, up to 24 blocks away. Sneak and use it to play single notes: look up for higher notes, down for lower. Carry a Music Sheet and play its notes in order to perform the song.
codex.thesift.crane_flute.title: Crane Flute
codex.thesift.deep_shrine.body: Hushslate shrines in the caves of the Deep Sift. Each holds an Echo Frame - your way home - and a chest that sometimes keeps a Warden Core. Riveters roost nearby.
codex.thesift.deep_shrine.title: Deep Shrine
codex.thesift.dictator.body: He rises from his Mask on the Grand Stage, wearing what he stole from his three great players, and every blow of his leaves Sculk Corruption. First the Thumper's shell: huge, slamming and charging - hits from behind clank off. Then the Whistler's wings: he flies and locks his song on you; break its line. Last the Strummer's strings: webs, a string that drags you in, a brood that grows stronger. Between movements he transforms - wait for him to land.
codex.thesift.dictator.title: The Conductor
codex.thesift.enchoer.body: A big mound of mint fur with moose antlers and a melancholy face. Enchoers trade saplings, seeds, drums, pearls and the occasional Warden Core. Play music near one and it spreads its arms and hums along. It hides its face when hurt.
codex.thesift.enchoer.title: Enchoer
codex.thesift.encore_sigil.body: Violet sigils in old floors. The Thumper waits in its Drum Pit - an arena with four towers - the Whistler in roofed Towers, the Strummer in some Deep Shrines. Walk up to one and its player comes out, once.
codex.thesift.encore_sigil.title: Encore Sigils
codex.thesift.euphory_altar.body: Set an item on the altar, surround it with Sift Drums and feed it a Chrome Pearl. The drums play themselves, the rings spin up and the item comes out enchanted beyond what a table can do.
codex.thesift.euphory_altar.title: Euphory Altar
codex.thesift.fanfare_eel.body: A long sculk eel with pale bone ribs, a glowing line down its flank and a golden trumpet bell for a mouth, ringed with glowing fins. It hunts anything swimming in the Chrome lakes - fish and visitors alike - and every bite comes with a blast of sound. Fight it from the shore if you can.
codex.thesift.fanfare_eel.title: Fanfare Eel
codex.thesift.flora.body: Coral Bushes and tall Coral Thickets grow thick across the salmon Coral Turf of the Sift Plains, under pale weeping Lullwood trees.
codex.thesift.flora.title: Coral Flora
codex.thesift.guitar.body: Planks and Sculk String from the Sculk Spiders. Every strum plays one note, and where you look picks it: look up for the high notes, down for the low ones - two octaves, like a note block. Learn a Music Sheet and you can play its song.
codex.thesift.guitar.title: Guitar
codex.thesift.harmoner.body: Feed a Harmoner seeds and it sings, takes off and leads you somewhere, waiting if you fall behind. Its colour tells you where: Rose - Abandoned Altar. Azure - Chrome Well. Gold - Dream Statue. Violet - Collapsed Tower. Jade - Sift Ruins. Coral - Musical Temple. The rare Night - the Sculk Castle.
codex.thesift.harmoner.title: Harmoner
codex.thesift.kazoo_fish.body: Teal schooling fish with coral fins, a pink kazoo for a nose, a tuft of moss on top and eyes that never quite agree. Schools follow a leader and buzz little tunes; scare one and they all scatter. Cook them for a decent meal.
codex.thesift.kazoo_fish.title: Kazoo Fish
codex.thesift.music.body: Many Sift creatures react to music: Bulbs dance, Enchoers hum, Harmoners sing along and Riveters fall still. Soul Chimes ring when powered; Dream Snares lull whatever steps in them to sleep.
codex.thesift.music.title: Music & Chimes
codex.thesift.musical_cobweb.body: The Weaver's glowing webs. They barely hold you - a little drag and a springy bounce - but every strand is tuned and plays its note when touched, so a web plays runs as you push through it. Shears or Silk Touch keep the web; otherwise it leaves Sculk String.
codex.thesift.musical_cobweb.title: Musical Cobweb
codex.thesift.musical_temple.body: Old temples of song. Tune each Harmony Stone to the colour of its pedestal to open the vault below.
codex.thesift.musical_temple.title: Musical Temple
codex.thesift.portal.body: Find the great gate in an Ancient City, or build a frame of Echo Frames. Set a Sift Drum near it with three Sculk Sensors around and slot in a Warden Core. The drum calls a rhythm, a rising note per beat: play it back on the drum. Three rounds right and the gate wakes.
codex.thesift.portal.tagline: A rhythm at the Ancient City
codex.thesift.portal.title: The Way In
codex.thesift.prism_instruments.body: Inlay an instrument with prism gems and it sings stronger. The Prism Flute's beam reaches further, hits harder and pierces everything along its line. The Prism Drum's shockwave rolls half as far again and rings out sooner. The Prism Harp heals you, your friends and your tamed creatures a little with every note it plays.
codex.thesift.prism_instruments.title: Prism Instruments
codex.thesift.riveter.body: It hangs head-down from cave ceilings in the Deep Sift with its long claws dangling. When it sees you it flings its arms open and screams - and every Warden nearby comes running. Sneak past it, or play music to lull it.
codex.thesift.riveter.title: Riveter
codex.thesift.ruins.body: Sift Ruins, Collapsed Towers, Abandoned Altars and Dream Statues are scattered across the surface. Brush suspicious dreamsand for relics and read the Dream Journal Fragments you find.
codex.thesift.ruins.title: Ruins & Statues
codex.thesift.sculk_castle.body: A tower of sculk and hushslate. Inside, a spiral of steps climbs the wall - jump the gaps, mind the crumbling ones, rest at the lantern ledges. Slime catches you if you fall. On the roof waits the Grand Stage, and its three empty altars.
codex.thesift.sculk_castle.title: The Sculk Castle
codex.thesift.sculk_corruption.body: A slow wither: one heart of harm every few seconds - but the longer it lasts, the more the dark closes in from the edges of your sight, until the world is a pinhole. Every blow from the Conductor adds to it. Milk washes it away.
codex.thesift.sculk_corruption.title: Sculk Corruption
codex.thesift.sculk_parasite.body: A Warden-kin centipede the size of your arm: bone plates, a glowing sting and far too many legs. It skitters up walls, coils and lunges - and the moment it bites, it bursts, leaving Sculk Corruption II in you. Every extra parasite that gets you deepens it a level. Squash them before they reach you: they only take a couple of hits.
codex.thesift.sculk_parasite.title: Sculk Parasite
codex.thesift.sift_cake.body: Baked from Glowing Slime Balls and Sift produce. Each slice restores a little hunger and leaves you glowing softly for a moment.
codex.thesift.sift_cake.title: Sift Cake
codex.thesift.sift_drum.body: Left- or right-click to play a beat; hold for a drum roll. Sneak and left-click to break it. Stone beneath booms low, wood thumps, anything else taps high. Redstone plays it too. Every beat ripples out to altars and Sift creatures and sets off Sculk Sensors, like a note block.
codex.thesift.sift_drum.title: Sift Drum
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.body: Feed a wild Sniffer Pitcher Bulbs or torchflower seeds until it trusts you, then put a saddle on it and climb up. A ridden Sniffer ploughs straight through soft ground in its way and every so often lifts its nose and marks buried treasure nearby with a trail of glowing dust.
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.tagline: Tame it, saddle it, ride it
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.title: Sniffer
codex.thesift.sifter.body: A box of a head with a lid that snaps open like a trap. Sifters burrow in the dunes with only the lid showing and burst out when you come close. Watch the sand for a lid that breathes.
codex.thesift.sifter.title: Sifter
codex.thesift.siftite.body: Smelt Serbim ore into ingots and alloy them with copper to make Siftite. Siftite tools and armour are upgraded from copper gear at a smithing table with the Siftite Upgrade template, found in temples and towers.
codex.thesift.siftite.title: Siftite Gear
codex.thesift.sky_whale.body: A shaggy whale-bull with cloud-soft fur, a meadow of blooms on its back and glowbell vines trailing below, rowing through the sky on furry flippers. If you spot one, you're lucky. Play the crane flute up at the sky with a tamed Harmoner beside you and the whale glides down, sings to you and spits out a Skysong Gem - one a day per whale.
codex.thesift.sky_whale.tagline: Rare - the singer in the clouds
codex.thesift.sky_whale.title: Sky Whale
codex.thesift.skysong_gem.body: Spat out by a Sky Whale that answered your song. Set one below an apple in a ring of gold blocks to craft an Enchanted Golden Apple.
codex.thesift.skysong_gem.title: Skysong Gem
codex.thesift.slingshot.body: Fires Glowing Slime Balls. A fully drawn shot bursts into light where it lands - and a direct hit on a Warden leaves it Deafened, unable to hear you for a while.
codex.thesift.slingshot.title: Slingshot
codex.thesift.slumbler.body: Huge, wide-mouthed and mostly asleep. Slumblers lounge in the Chrome lakes, yawn enormously and drop Thick Hide - and sometimes a Chrome Pearl. Let sleeping Slumblers lie: they bite.
codex.thesift.slumbler.title: Slumbler
codex.thesift.songs.body: Every instrument plays single notes: look up for higher notes, down for lower - a ladder beside the crosshair shows the note. Sheets of music hide in the chests of the old ruins, towers, temples and shrines. Hold one to read its notes; use it to pin it on screen. Carry the sheet and play its notes in order, with no more than two seconds between them, to perform the song. The Lullaby puts monsters to sleep and opens Harmony Seals; the Whale Song calls a Sky Whale. Other songs wake golems, calm colonies, open drowned vaults and begin the Echoer's trade.
codex.thesift.songs.title: Songs & Music Sheets
codex.thesift.staff.body: His tuning-fork staff, taken from his hand. Use it to cast a beam of song: every creature it touches is Entranced for three seconds - it stops, forgets its target and just sings. Sneak and use it to call the orchestra: a Sculk Harmoner appears and circles you for twenty seconds, its song keeping you strong, fast, healing and hard to hurt.
codex.thesift.staff.title: Conductor's Staff
codex.thesift.stage.body: On the roof of the Sculk Castle stands a stage with three empty altars. Place the Conga Drum, the Crane Flute and the Weaver's Guitar on them and they begin to play together. The sky darkens. The world falls silent. And from beneath the stage, a mask rises...
codex.thesift.stage.title: The Grand Stage
codex.thesift.stomper.body: Four eyes, one trunk, no tusks - and a whole garden of moss and coral on its back. Stompers slurp Chrome through their trunks and hose any monster (or you, if you hit one) with it. Drums make them dance, ending in two stomps that send monsters flying. Feed two Hummingblooms for an egg; tame babies with them and they grow up to carry you.
codex.thesift.stomper.title: Stomper
codex.thesift.strumling.body: Long-legged spiders of bone and sculk, eight eyes glowing over hooked fangs and glowing sacs bulging between the plates of their backs. They skitter up walls, walk through webs and, when they sink down and rear their front legs, pounce. They drop Sculk String.
codex.thesift.strumling.title: Sculk Spider
codex.thesift.strummer.body: A great sculk spider that crawls up out of the ground when woken, a bone mantis on its back playing the glowing strings of its silk. It fights in three movements. First it slashes, spits silk, pounces, snaps a string to drag you in, lays Sculk Spiders and strums them stronger. Two thirds down it roars and rings itself in webs: now it runs up the walls, fires a thread to the ceiling and swings across the arena to drop on you, and weaves an orb of Musical Cobwebs around you in a blink - watch for the ring of light. At one third it roars again: faster, and every strum makes its webs sing and hurt. Drops the Weaver's Guitar.
codex.thesift.strummer.tagline: Strings - a sculk spider and its bone musician
codex.thesift.strummer.title: The Weaver
codex.thesift.thumper.body: A giant turtle with a war drum on its shell: only hits on the DRUM hurt it. Jump its slam rings; a charge into a wall leaves it dazed. At half health it grows into a TITAN, and then only blows struck from its back count. Climb a tower of its Drum Pit and leap on. Crouch when it shakes; hide from its beam. Drops its Conga Drum.
codex.thesift.thumper.tagline: Percussion - a turtle and its war drum
codex.thesift.thumper.title: The Thumper
codex.thesift.tubafish.body: A huge, round periwinkle pufferfish freckled with glowing spots, with a tuba bell on its back crowned by a little waving anemone. Get too close and it blasts a low note, swells up with its coral spikes out and blows a storm of bubbles - and touching it then stings. Drops Tuba Bubbles, which make a Bubble Gun.
codex.thesift.tubafish.title: Tubafish
codex.thesift.vocals.body: When the Dictator reaches his crescendo, a Warden claws up through the floor to sing for him. A Glowing Slime Ball from a slingshot leaves it Deafened.
codex.thesift.vocals.title: The Vocals
codex.thesift.warden_core.body: Taken from a Warden or found in the deepest shrines. In a Sift Drum it leads the ritual that opens the way to The Sift, and speaks for you: sensors hear the beats, shriekers can't tell who played. Sneak and use the drum to take it out.
codex.thesift.warden_core.title: Warden Core
codex.thesift.weaver_guitar.body: It plays like any guitar, one note a strum. Sneak and strum to weave: a ring of Musical Cobwebs springs up around you and every hostile creature nearby is snared in silk where it stands - bounced, bound and slowed. Then the strings need a few seconds to settle. Only the Weaver drops it, and only it will sound on the Grand Stage.
codex.thesift.weaver_guitar.title: Weaver's Guitar
codex.thesift.whistler.body: A giant sculk crane that wheels overhead trailing souls. When a thin line of light finds you, its song is about to lock on: a beam that ignores armour and keeps hurting you, slowly, as long as it holds. Break the lock - duck behind something solid, run, or hit it hard and it falls out of the sky. Drops its Crane Beak.
codex.thesift.whistler.tagline: Wind - a crane with a flute for a beak
codex.thesift.whistler.title: The Whistler
codex.thesift.whistling.body: Fluffy crane chicks with flute beaks. From a few blocks away they pipe a shrill note that stings through armour.
codex.thesift.whistling.title: Whistling
entity.thesift.thumper.titan: The Thumper, Titan of the Deep
item.thesift.music_sheet.hint: Use to pin it on screen. Carry it and play these notes on any instrument.
item.thesift.music_sheet_nib: Music Sheet: Song of the Nibs
item.thesift.smithing_template.siftite_u: Add copper armor, weapon, or tool
message.thesift.altar.need_drums: The altar needs at least two Sift Drums around it.
message.thesift.altar.need_levels: You need more experience to perform the ritual.
message.thesift.dictator.wakes: The Conductor raises his staff. The performance begins...
message.thesift.drum.core_spent: The Warden Core is pouring itself into the gate.
message.thesift.drum.need_core: The gate is listening! Slot a Warden Core into the drum to begin the ritual.
message.thesift.drum.need_sensors: The drum needs three Sculk Sensors within 8 blocks to listen (%s found).
message.thesift.drum.no_frame: No portal frame answers the drum. Build one of Echo Frames or find an Ancient City gate.
message.thesift.drum.opened: The way to The Sift is open.
message.thesift.drum.round_done: The sculk hums in harmony... %s of %s
message.thesift.drum.waiting: The drum falls quiet. Strike it when you are ready to play.
message.thesift.drum.your_turn: Your turn! Play the rhythm back on the drum (round %s of %s)
message.thesift.encore.0: The ground shakes to a war drum... the Thumper answers the call!
message.thesift.encore.1: A flute sings from the sky... the Whistler answers the call!
message.thesift.encore.2: Silk trembles in the dark... the Weaver claws its way up!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.azure: The Azure Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Chrome Well!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.coral: The Coral Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Musical Temple!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.gold: The Gold Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Dream Statue!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.jade: The Jade Harmoner sings and takes off towards the Sift Ruins!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.night: The Night Harmoner sings a dark little tune and takes off towards the Sculk Castle...
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.rose: The Rose Harmoner sings and takes off towards an Abandoned Altar!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.violet: The Violet Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Collapsed Tower!
message.thesift.harmoner.lost: The Harmoner tilts its head. It cannot sense any place of its colour nearby.
message.thesift.harmoner.tamed: The Harmoner chirps and settles on your shoulder. It will follow you - and sing along with your flute.
message.thesift.sky_whale.gem: The Sky Whale sings back - and spits out a glittering Skysong Gem!
message.thesift.sky_whale.heard: Far above, something vast hears your song...
message.thesift.sky_whale.no_gem: The Sky Whale sings back warmly. It has no gem left to give today.
message.thesift.sniffer.tamed: The Sniffer nuzzles you. It trusts you now - give it a saddle and ride it!
message.thesift.sniffer.treasure: Your Sniffer smells treasure %s blocks away!
message.thesift.staff.summon: The orchestra answers - a Sculk Harmoner sings for you!
message.thesift.stage.begins: The three instruments begin to play together...
message.thesift.stomper.tamed: The little Stomper trumpets and nuzzles you with its trunk. It is yours now!
message.thesift.titan.awaken: The sculk in its shell is waking... the Thumper is growing!
message.thesift.titan.climb: Your blows glance off its hide - get up on its back!
message.thesift.titan.leap: It is right below you - leap onto its back!
message.thesift.titan.parasites: Sculk Parasites are crawling out of its shell! (Crouch to hold on when it shakes.)
message.thesift.titan.risen: The Thumper rises as a titan! Nothing hurts it from the ground - climb a tower and leap onto its back!
song.thesift.crystal.desc: The Caravans' hymn: it calms a colony.
song.thesift.lullaby.desc: Puts nearby monsters to sleep and opens Harmony Seals.
song.thesift.nib.desc: The Nibs of the Sound Garden dance to it.
song.thesift.offering.desc: Play it beside an offering and the Echoer will trade.
song.thesift.tide.desc: Opens the drowned vaults of the deep and calms the Gobbler.
song.thesift.whale.desc: A Sky Whale nearby will come and sing back.
subtitles.thesift.entity.bulb.lay: Bulb plops out a slime ball
subtitles.thesift.entity.dictator.cresce: The Dictator builds to a crescendo
subtitles.thesift.entity.sky_whale.spit: Sky Whale spits out a gem
